genuinely_new.why: no accepted receipt binds a reachable materialised register/stack site (ssh's 7 materialised sites were unreachable)

caveats: Fix shape is a triage assignment. (a) for materialised sites whose enclosing function is a documented callback/provider/engine ABI is an inference from the function role and the imported-symbol set; the per-call-site contract witness is the resolution work itself.
